# Nomadic Samuel Article Corpus

This dataset contains 422 long-form English article records from Nomadic Samuel.

Canonical dataset:
https://huggingface.co/datasets/samuelandaudreymedianetwork/nomadic-samuel-article-corpus

Zenodo DOI:
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18665493

Source website:
https://nomadicsamuel.com

Recommended files:
- nomadic-samuel.jsonl
- nomadic-samuel.csv
- DATA_DICTIONARY.md
- SCHEMA.json
- CITATION.cff

Records:
- 422 article records
